task:
Create a ServiceAccount with token automounting disabled and use it in a Pod.

In namespace 'neptune':

  1. Create namespace 'neptune' if it does not exist.

  2. Create a ServiceAccount named 'neptune-sa-v2' in namespace 'neptune' with:
     automountServiceAccountToken: false

  3. Create a Deployment named 'neptune-10ab' in namespace 'neptune' with:
     - Replicas: 3
     - Image: httpd:2.4-alpine
     - Container name: neptune-pod-10ab
     - Resource requests: memory=20Mi
     - Resource limits:   memory=50Mi
     - serviceAccountName: neptune-sa-v2

Verify:
  kubectl get sa neptune-sa-v2 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.automountServiceAccountToken}'
  # Expected: false

  kubectl get deploy neptune-10ab -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName}'
  # Expected: neptune-sa-v2

  kubectl exec -n neptune <pod-name> -- ls /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/
  # Should show empty or not mounted (token not present)
hints: kubectl create sa neptune-sa-v2 -n neptune --dry-run=client -o yaml  then add automountServiceAccountToken: false
detailed_hints: ServiceAccount YAML: apiVersion: v1, kind: ServiceAccount, metadata: {name: neptune-sa-v2, namespace: neptune}, automountServiceAccountToken: false
Deployment: kubectl create deploy neptune-10ab --image=httpd:2.4-alpine --replicas=3 -n neptune --dry-run=client -o yaml
Add to deploy spec.template.spec: serviceAccountName: neptune-sa-v2

validators.command: kubectl get sa neptune-sa-v2 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get deploy neptune-10ab -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'
